item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J00535","case1_error":"Evaluates 80 − 16 as 40 instead of 64.","case2_error":"Evaluates 200 − 60 − 56 as 184 instead of 84.","reason":"Both incorrectly evaluate correctly written subtraction expressions, then carry the erroneous values into their answers.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J00536","case1_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 35 × 0.2857 as 9.5; the exact required amount is 10 pounds.","case2_error":"Divides by servings per batch twice, treating 15 batches as 15 servings and consequently making too few batches.","reason":"The first is numerical evaluation of a correct scaling expression; the second constructs an erroneous scaling relation through double division.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00537","case1_error":"No mathematical error: correctly inverts the speed ratio and obtains a total of 40.5 hours.","case2_error":"Simplifies 13 + 7 + 30 to 40 instead of 50, producing 80 rather than 100 pieces.","reason":"The first solution correctly answers the question despite the faulty reference; only the second has a clear mathematical error.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J00538","case1_error":"Gives an unsupported final value of 200 after correct formulas; those formulas yield a $600 increase.","case2_error":"Uses remaining members × days as messages, omitting the factor of 50 messages per member per day.","reason":"The first supplies an incorrect number without showing its calculation; the second explicitly writes an erroneous relation omitting a required rate factor.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00539","case1_error":"Uses the false conversion factor 1.16 ounces per pound instead of 16.","case2_error":"Replaces the exact multiplier 4/3 with 1.33, producing 284.75 towels instead of 285.","reason":"The first uses an incorrect unit conversion; the second prematurely approximates a repeating decimal and reports the resulting inexact count.","judgment":"different"}]}
